ov: نيويورك، نيويورك فيلم أمريكي غنائي من عام 1977 من إخراج مارتن سكورسيزي.
plotEn:
On V-J Day in 1945, during a celebration at the Rainbow Room nightclub in New York City, with music provided by the Tommy Dorsey Orchestra, selfish and smooth-talking saxophone player Jimmy Doyle pesters small-time USO singer Francine Evans for her phone number; she declines, wanting nothing to do with him. Coincidentally, his army comrade Eddie DiMuzio has picked up her best friend Ellen Flannery, and both borrow Jimmy's hotel room for the night. When Francine goes to the hotel the next morning looking for Ellen, she notices Jimmy in the lobby, who has been evicted for not paying his weekly hotel bill. Jimmy jumps into Francine's taxi cab and, against her will, she accompanies him to an audition at the Palm Club, where he argues with the club owner. Attempting to get the audition back on track, Francine begins to sing the old standard "You Brought a New Kind of Love to Me", with Jimmy joining in on his saxophone. Impressed, the club owner hires them as a boy-girl act, astonishing Francine.
Francine promises to see Jimmy the next day, but the following morning, her agent Tony Harwell approaches him with a message from her, explaining that she has joined a traveling orchestra led by Frankie Harte. Abandoning the Palm Club, he pursues her and joins the ensemble. Immediately frustrated at being unable to perform his own, more progressive music, he shares with her a composition he constructed and offers to let her provide lyrics if she shares her poetry with him. Touched to disco
